competency_fulfillment.rationale: 'Read and write unit fractions in fraction notation' requires translating between the spoken name 'one-eighth' and the symbol 1/8, but every seed 42-46 serves the shape-shading identification item copied verbatim from mat_g2_na_q4_0. No sample asks the pupil to read a fraction name or write notation from words.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Neither direction of the read/write pair is generated across seeds 42-46: there is no words-to-symbol prompt and no symbol-to-words prompt, and the only notation the node ever produces is 1/8, so the writing half of the competency has no representation at all.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The two short declaratives plus one question ('1 part is shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?') are within Grade 2 Quarter 4 decoding range and require exactly one reasoning step, counting the shaded part against the total of 8.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Every seed reuses one context, a nameless 'shape'. There is no halves-versus-thirds contrast, no concrete framing such as a bibingka or ribbon, and no fill-in-the-blank writing task, so the notation-production variant is entirely absent.

competency_alignment.rationale: Difficulty never moves: seeds 42-46 share an identical stem and an identical key of 1/8, so nothing scaffolds a learner from reading a symbol that is given to writing one independently, which is the intended arc of this competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Only eighths are ever written, and the distractor 3/16 puts a sixteenth on the page - notation outside the Grade 2 unit-fraction range that this reading-and-writing node is bounded by.
